body:
I added a comment providing context, but I did not mention QMK because the issue should affect any keyboard with a keypad whose scancodes get translated to these keypad keysym codes with X11. I can test on a Logitech keyboard to confirm.

I speculate that QMK users are disproportionately affected due to being more likely to use custom layouts and layers which include the numpad. I personally use a 34-key keyboard, and I use a layer button to access the keypad in order to press = for ergonomics.

tl;dr:
I don't think it has to do with QMK, but I need to check later :)

edit:
I do not have access to a keyboard with a dedicated keypad equals button (these seem rare), but I am sure the issue will be present regardless of firmware.
